study_summary.objective: Test how overexpressing the candidate omega-3 desaturase gene AO090010000714 changes the transcriptome of A. oryzae RIB40 (from the BioProject title).
study_summary.experimental_design: RNA-seq of RIB40 wild type and an overexpression strain (AT24), one library each; culture medium, temperature and time are not stated in the BioProject or BioSamples.
study_summary.main_finding: Not available: no accession-linked paper was found, so no result is reported here.

tags.note: wild-type reference for the overexpression strain

notes: No accession-linked paper found; how the overexpression strain was built and how it was cultured are unknown.
Both samples have an empty strain field in the SRA run table; the BioSample records say strain RIB40 (NBRC 100959).
